projects.title: BEAT THE INIT SELECTA
projects.description: Our team created a CGI montage for Selecta’s new flavors: Crunchy Choco Malt, Avocado Dream, and New York Cheesecake. Using Houdini, Blender, and After Effects, we simulated realistic textures and dynamics, bringing each ingredient and flavor to life in a visually captivating way.

projects.title: PENSHOPPE - BRIGHTER DAYS AHEAD
projects.description: A lifestyle-driven fashion campaign centered on optimism and everyday ease. As the post-production team, we executed the Crew Bear animation and 3D elements—integrating stylized motion seamlessly into the campaign’s cinematic visuals to enhance storytelling while maintaining a clean, elevated brand aesthetic.

projects.title: GRWM -ALL DAY ALLIES
projects.description: A narrative-driven campaign crafted to highlight our filmmaking and storytelling strength—proving compelling visuals can stand independently without reliance on heavy VFX. Moving beyond our core specialization, the project focuses on capturing authentic, everyday beauty moments while positioning GRWM’s products as dependable, all-day essentials.

projects.title: SAILUN TIRE
projects.description: An exclusive, cinematic film premiere titled "Rise as Champions of the Road" for Sailun Tire Philippines. We elevated the automotive brand's motivational messaging through high-end VFX and CGI integration. Our visual effects work added premium production value, creating a visually striking piece that celebrates excellence and the drive to conquer any journey.

projects.title: DEARFACE
projects.description: A social-first beauty campaign promoting skincare and wellness through aspirational, glow-focused visuals. As the post-production team, we refined and elevated the content through polished editing and finishing—ensuring a cohesive, premium look aligned with the brand’s confidence-driven narrative.
